tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// slob dpon phya pa la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ brtse chen spros bral gnyis su med pa'i sku ldan pa// ston pa 'jig rten 'dren la gus pas phyag 'tshal te// gang gi drin gyis bdag blo'i padma 'byed mdzad pa// bla ma dam pa de la dwang bas bstod par bgyi// dpal ldan dpag med dus nas sbyin sdom thos la sogs// dge chos bsam gyis mi khyab rab tu bskrun mdzad rgyus// rigs gzugs blo gros brtson sogs mchog gis rab brgyan pa// dal zhing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa bzang po'i gzhir// rang bzhin gyis gnas rigs gyur thar pa'i sa bon la// bshes gnyen dam pa'i chu bos rnam par brlan byas pas// dang dad yid ches mngon par 'dod dang bcas pa yi// dad pa'i rtsa ba bzang po ma nyams brtan pa can// chos 'dul legs par gsungs pa bslab pa'i dam chos las// sdom gsum ldan par tshul khrims legs blangs sdong po can// rang bzhin bcas pa'i nye tshogs mi 'byung phra mo yang*// mi nyams bsrung ba'i yal gas rab tu mdzes pa po// kun nas dul ba'i lo 'dab rab tu rgyas gyur pa// grags pa'i dri yis phyogs rnams kun tu rnam khyab pas// skal ldan skye bo bung ba'i khyu mchog 'dus pa rnams// nyon mongs gdung ba gsung gis skyob pa'i bsil grib can// mngon mtho'i me tog thar pa'i 'bras bu gdul bya yi// sred pa zil mngar ro yis tshim mdzad ljon pa'i shing*// 'jig rten gtam grags phya ltar tshul khrims bkod mdzad pa// mkhan po chen po lhag pa'i tshul khrims dge 'dun bstod// nyon mongs rtsa stong sred pa'i 'khri shing dam po'i nags// 'dod yon lo 'bras longs spyod rang dgar rnam 'khyams las// bag yod nyams dga' dge ldan rgyal po'i pho brang du// bshes gnyen dam pas yongs su bkug pa'i glang po che// rtog pas mi bsgul kun nas brtan pa'i zhi gnas lus// mtha' gnyis g.yang sa spong bas kun nas rab 'gying zhing*// bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i rmig pa'i gom stabs rab tu 'gyur// dran pa'i lcags kyus 'dun pa'i kha lo bsgyur ba can// lam gnyis man ngag rin chen drwa bas khebs pa'i gdong*// thun bzhir mnyam 'jog spro ldan bzlas la brtson pa'i dbugs// rtog pa'i gzigs bral shes bya'i mtha' kun gzigs pa'i spyan// tshig 'bru spangs kyang gsung rab don rtogs snyan ldan pa// rnam g.yeng nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'jebs par 'thag pa yi// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel gnam lcags ral gri can// sgrib pa lnga spangs mche ba rno dkar gyis mdzes pa'i// sems kyi bslab pa'i glang chen bla ma khyod phyag 'tshal// skyes thob blo gros mchog ldan rab tu brtan pa'i gzhi// rtog ge'i gzhung lugs mang thos sra brtan brtsegs pa'i spo// bde bar gshegs gsung dri med lung gi kha ba yis// rnam par dkar gyur thos pa'i gangs kyi ri yi rtser// rigs tshul sbyangs pa las byung bsam pa mthar phyin lus// blo gros shugs chen rtsal ldan rigs pa yangs pa'i brang*// rigs tshul thogs med kun la go mdzad yan lag can// gzhung gzhan 'jigs bskyed bdag med don rtogs brjid ldan dbu// rtog pa'i yul la dpyod blos rab tu gzhig gyur nas// dus mtha' rdul mtha' thug med gzigs pa'i spyan dmar ba// ldog rdzas tha dad gcig gyur gcig la tha dad tshul// bsam yas 'dres dang ma 'dres mkhyen pa'i ral pa can// dpyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu yangs pa'i zhal mdzes la// 'gal 'brel rigs pa las grub rno dkar mche ba gtsigs/

spros bral chos kyi ro yis kun nas tshim pa'i ljags// dngos 'dzin ri dwags skrag mdzad stong nyid nga ro sgrogs// bden gnyis don rtogs dpal ldan shugs chen gom stabs kyis// phyi rgol glang chen dregs pa'i mgo bor rnam 'phyangs te// sdeb sbyor ma dkrugs gsal ba'i sder mo rab rno bas// lta ngan klad khrag ma lus rtsad nas 'don mdzad 'dud// e ma lhag pa'i shes rab bslab ldan sa steng na// do zla kun spangs seng ge dang mtshungs rtogs gyur nas// ston phyir ston pa sangs rgyas bla ma don ldan mtshan// phya ba chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// bslab pa gsum dang de bzhin dkon mchog gsum gyi don// ljon shing che dang glang po che dang seng ge'i dpes// gsal byed de dag bla ma'i mtshan dang ldan par bstod pa yi// sdeb sbyor 'di ni 'phags pa'i dbyangs zhes ming du grags// kye ma kyi hud kyi hud snyigs ma'i dus gyur cing*// thub pa'i bstan pa rnyings pas sa mo glang gi lo'i// nag pa zla ba'i nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la// dge legs gang zag mchog khyod gshegs zhes bdag gis khums// gdul bya'i skye bo skal ldan 'dus par gyur pa rnams// lta ngan drwa ba sna tshogs rab tu dral ba dang*// spyod ngan tshang tshing ma lus rjes gzhig mdzad pa yi// gzhan don dgongs mdzad bshol nas skyes mchog gang du bzhud// le lo'i dbang gis gom stabs 'khyor bas rnam g.yeng gi /chom pos phrogs shing yun ring rnam par 'khyams gyur pa// bdag la'ang mi bzhugs dpa' khyod myur bas gshegs gyur pas// kyi hud kyi hud ces bya'i tshig ni 'dir byas lags// 'on kyang khyod gsung bden gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i don// thos pa las rnyed chos kun sgyu ma dang mtshungs par// rtogs pa'i myu gu cung zad shar ba gang lags pa// 'di la bsam par bgyis las bdag gis gzhan ci bgyi// gzhan yang khyod gshegs gyur yang thugs sogs mchod pa'i rten// skal dman gzung phyir bzhag la'ang yun du bzhugs pa dang*// ring bsrel mchod la khyad par med par bde gshegs gsung*// de phyir mchod rten bdag gi mchod dman dag gis mchod// glegs bam phul la bsod nams mchog phyir rgyal ba'i yum// glegs bam thub pa gnyis dang de bzhin rin chen tog

/bkod mdzes byed dang shing gi snying po tshes zla ba// 'byor dman 'dis mchod da dung khyod la mchod par smon// thog med srid par ma rig rgyus byung nyes pa'i tshogs// bag chags gang bsags de 'dir bshags bgyi slan chad bsdam// zla med skyes bu khyod la dam pa gzhan mchod dang*// gzhan yang dge gang mdzad pa de la rjes yi rang*// ji srid bdag gis 'khor ba'i skye bar khyod kyi zhabs// bsten cing dam pa'i chos kyi gsung sgra sgrogs par bskul// 'gro ba'i ma rig ji srid gsal bar ma gyur par// sku tshe'i 'du byed mi 'dzad bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// zla med mi yi seng ge skyes bu mchog khyod la// bstod mchod bgyis las bsod nams thob pa gang yin pa// de yi 'di nas dam pa khyed kyi drung nyid du// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bsten pa byed par shog /bla ma dam pa khyod thugs kun tu mi skyo bar// bdag sems dwang ba'i spyod pas kun tu bsten byed cing*// dge gsum don gnyis ldan pa bde bar gshegs gsung gi /dgongs don rnam 'byed thos bsam byed la brtson 'gyur shog /rten cing 'brel 'byung spros kun chad pa'i rang bzhin can// rnal 'byor ldan pas sna tshogs rtog pa'i drwa ba kun// rab tu dral te gnyis med ye shes mchog thob nas// ma rig ldongs pa'i 'gro la lam mchog ston par shog /'dzam gling gangs can btsan po'i chab 'og bar gyi sa// ru bzhi gtsang stod 'bro yi sa cha grom pa'i stod// dam pa mang po'i bzhugs gnas dge legs snod gyur pa// grags pas rab mdzes sa skya zhes bya'i dben gnas su// chu mo sbrul gyi lo la snron gyi zla ba ste// nyi ma lug gi khyim gnas dkar po'i bcu gcig tshe// bla ma'i stod tshig yan lag bdun dang ldan gyur pa// sdeb sbyor tshig snyan don mang gsal bar bgyis pa 'di// bla gnyis dang ldan 'og dang bar yod 'khon gyi rus// mang du thos la mngon mtho'i blo gros mig ldan zhing*// dge bsnyen la slob theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa// bsod nams rtse mo bdag gis dwang bas sbyar bgyis te// dam pa'i bshes gnyen du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhi// bsod nams gzi brjid dang ldan mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas gyur// grags pas kun khyab dge slong du mas rab mdzes pa// dpal ldan ne'u thog gtsug lag khang du 'di 'bul lo// blo chen ldan rnams mgu bar byed pa'i phyir// 'di la blo gros ngan pas smod 'gyur mod// de phyir rtog dpyod ldan pa'i skye bo rnams// gsum bdun don ston bstod 'dir 'jug par rigs// slob dpon phya pa gshegs pa'i rjes su rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos dus dran la dmigs nas/

slob dpon phya pa'i sku 'dra thang sku chen po'i gsham na gong gi bstod pa 'di bris pa cig dang*/ phya pa sku 'bum la gser gyi 'gan ji ra chen po dang*/ gser gyi 'bum bcu gnyis dum/ maṇḍal chen po bdun tshar/ bur btang mang po dang bcas pa phul/ zhes pa yar lung bsam gtan gling pa'i dpe las 'byung ngo*// // ༄༅// bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs// ༄༅// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ.arha de bhyaḥ samyaka saṃ buddhe bhyo/ na ma ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bodhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭṭe biṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dzwa la ma pa nā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
